crew.overview: Decades since their successful television series was canceled, Chip has succumbed to a life of suburban domesticity as an insurance salesman. Dale, meanwhile, has had CGI surgery and works the nostalgia convention circuit, desperate to relive his glory days. When a former cast mate mysteriously disappears, Chip and Dale must repair their broken friendship and take on their Rescue Rangers detective personas once again to save their friend’s life.
crew.title: Chip 'n Dale: Rescue Rangers

crew.overview: Barbie and Ken are having the time of their lives in the colorful and seemingly perfect world of Barbie Land. However, when they get a chance to go to the real world, they soon discover the joys and perils of living among humans.
crew.title: Barbie

crew.overview: When her mother disappears while on vacation in Colombia with her new boyfriend, June’s search for answers is hindered by international red tape. Stuck thousands of miles away in Los Angeles, June creatively uses all the latest technology at her fingertips to try and find her before it’s too late. But as she digs deeper, her digital sleuthing raises more questions than answers... and when June unravels secrets about her mom, she discovers that she never really knew her at all.
crew.title: Missing

crew.overview: A tale of outsized ambition and outrageous excess, tracing the rise and fall of multiple characters in an era of unbridled decadence and depravity during Hollywood's transition from silent films to sound films in the late 1920s.
crew.title: Babylon

details.biography: Troy Castaneda began his life as a competitive gymnast training and competing for 12 years. He tore his hamstring during a competition which ultimately ended his gymnastics career. From there Troy did not slow down as he fell in love with racing cars with his first taste behind the wheel of a kart. He became one of the top drivers in the world representing the United States in two World Championship appearances. Troy soon moved into formula cars, relocating to Italy at 17 to race in the European circuit. Castaneda eventually moved back to the States and began racing various cars from Indy Lights to Prototypes and Sports Cars. Since 2012, Troy has switched his focus to the entertainment industry and as a performing acrobat, most recently performing in Le Reve in Las Vegas at the Wynn Hotel.
details.name: Troy Castaneda
